scenario.source_compounding_description: 10% annual rate of return with annual compounding

reproduction_note.status: derived implementation inference, not a formula stated in the thesis
reproduction_note.exact_match_formula: FV = C * (((1+i)^N - 1) / i) * (1+i), where i=(1+r)^(1/12)-1, N=12*t, C=monthly contribution
reproduction_note.interpretation: The displayed balances are reproduced to rounding by treating the 10% return as an effective annual return converted to an equivalent monthly rate and treating contributions as an annuity due (beginning of month).
reproduction_note.warning: The thesis text describes a 10% annual return with annual compounding. Because the displayed values exactly match the monthly annuity-due formulation above, confirm the intended convention before coding a generalized calculator. V1 should use the fixed displayed values rather than regenerate them.
